[08 86 B7 F3 00]
@(When you get in a battle with an enemy the world suddenly looks all swirly swirly.)
@(If you sneak up behind the enemy then the swirly swirl will be green.)
@(That means you'll get an extra turn at the start of the battle.)
@(Look out though!)
@(If an enemy catches you from behind then the spinny swirl will be red.)
@(Then they get an opening attack on you!)
@(You should always try to have the advantage when fighting.)
@(Whew...[10 1E] )
@(All this talk of swirly spinny swirls is making me dizzy...)
@Chirp[13][02]

[08 86 B7 F3 00]
@(I'm a frightened sparrow with scare-ow advice!)
@(If you see a scary ghost or zombie you can run!)
@(Just hold the Y button while moving around.)
@(If you've already been running around a lot, you've most definitely gotten tired.)
@(This is because you have limited stamina, so run sparrowingly.)
@(Running away from monsters for too long would be a nasty scenario.)
@Chirp[13][02]
